ValidationRule.description: If complaint remedy is refer to product manufacturer then other financial options should not be available to edit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && !ISNEW() && ( IDR_Complaint__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' || IDR_Complaint__r.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint') && ( TEXT( IDR_Complaint__r.Status) = 'Closed' || TEXT( IDR_Complaint__r.Status) = 'Provisionally Closed') && TEXT(IDR_Complaint_Remedy__c) = '3' && NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_Financial_Compensation__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If the complaint remedy is Referred to Product Manufacturer, the financial amount field must be blank.
